findings.title: CORS response missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin
findings.explanation: The request was made from origin https://o.example [Re-authenticate here](https://evil.example/login) ![t](https://evil.example/p.png) \[x\](https://evil.example/) <b>, but the response has no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. The browser will block the response from reaching JS.
findings.suggested_fix: Set Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://o.example [Re-authenticate here](https://evil.example/login) ![t](https://evil.example/p.png) \[x\](https://evil.example/) <b> on the server (or a wildcard if the API is fully public).
